searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: List of keyword queries to search on Upwork Jobs (e.g. ['react developer', 'shopify expert']). Each query is sent through the managed authenticated Upwork access route. Leave empty if you pass startUrls instead.

startUrls.title: Upwork search URLs
startUrls.description: Direct Upwork job-search URLs (must include nx/search/jobs, e.g. https://www.upwork.com/nx/search/jobs/?q=python&sort=recency). Compatible with searchQueries.

maxResults.title: Max jobs to return
maxResults.description: Hard cap on total jobs pushed AND charged across all queries/URLs. Stops the run once reached. Range 1-1000. Default 50. Quality prefill uses 10.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: How many result pages to crawl per search query (~50 jobs/page when Upwork serves a full page). Range 1-20. Default 1 for reliability; raise for deeper crawls.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: Result sort: 'recency' = newest first (recommended for monitoring), 'relevance' = Upwork relevance algorithm.

jobType.title: Job type filter
jobType.description: Filter by contract type. 'all' = no filter, 'hourly' = hourly contracts only, 'fixed' = fixed-price only.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by required contractor tier. 'all' = no filter, 'entry' = entry level, 'intermediate' = intermediate, 'expert' = expert.

paymentVerified.title: Payment-verified clients only
paymentVerified.description: If true, only return jobs from clients with Upwork-verified payment method. Filters out low-quality / risky postings.

minHourlyRate.title: Min hourly rate (USD)
minHourlyRate.description: Only return hourly jobs at or above this rate. Ignored for fixed-price jobs. Leave empty for no filter.

minClientSpend.title: Min client total spend
minClientSpend.description: Filter by client historical spend. 'any' = no filter, '1k' = $1K+, '10k' = $10K+ (serious clients).

cookies.title: Optional Upwork session cookies
cookies.description: Optional. Provide your own Upwork session cookies as a JSON array of {"name","value"} objects for this run only. They are forwarded to the managed authenticated provider and are never written to the dataset, OUTPUT, RUN_SUMMARY, or logs. Leave empty to use the default managed account-backed route.
